explanation: The quality-foundation implementation is technically strong and current-head CI passes, but one ontology/codebook design issue must be corrected before acceptance. core_knowledge_taxonomy.v1 intentionally separates acquisition_technique, failure_boundary_type, semantic_interpretation, evidence_type, execution_environment, and other dimensions. core_knowledge_codebook.v1 currently requires every codebook entry to have code_kind=semantic_code while also codebooking AT-* acquisition-technique IDs and FB-* failure-boundary IDs as semantic codes. This collapses operational/category codes into semantic interpretation and weakens the Code != Theme != Descriptor discipline we are trying to establish. The evidence chain and documentation also hard-code the stage name Semantic Code. Correct the model so a code remains distinct from Descriptor and Theme, while code family/dimension is preserved explicitly. A technique code must remain an acquisition-technique code; a failure-boundary code must remain a failure-boundary code; only SI-* entries are semantic-interpretation codes. Add an optional explicit Theme object or theme layer so Theme is not silently represented as Interpretation. Preserve backward compatibility, raw-evidence immutability, iterative coding, negative/deviant cases, analytical memos, finding verification, independent coding, reliability, ontology openness, candidate boundaries, and all non-production/non-ML guarantees.
